name: motion-explainer
description: Explain how a mechanism works with a short video of one running example, scene by scene, with a narrator, art drawn as SVG for each subject, and figures drawn from the same art, as one offline HTML page

interface.longDescription: Explains how a system or a process works by playing one running example from start to end as a short video, such as one request that reaches a server or one parcel that is delivered again. For each subject the agent writes an art direction and draws a narrator and the objects on the stage as SVG, so two subjects never share a look. Each scene changes one thing, the narrator says one sentence about it, and only the parts that changed are marked. The player has play, pause, replay, and a chapter per scene, and shows each scene at its end for readers who ask for reduced motion. Figures under the video answer one question each and are drawn from the same art. Art that would load from outside or run a script is refused before anything is written, and the page opens offline.
defaultPrompt: Explain how a cache answers a request as a short video with figures
